pages.title: Kebiishi
pages.text: Kebiishi (けんぴいし) are law enforcement officers responsible for patrolling and apprehending lawbreakers. In this mod, they are known for their formidable combat prowess and serve as a hostile force that players may encounter during exploration.$(br2)As a third-party faction, Kebiishi are hostile to both the Retrograde Army and the player along with their Touken Danshi.

pages.title: Spawn Mechanics
pages.text: Kebiishi will begin attempting to spawn once the player's total kill count exceeds 100 for the first time, divided into five spawn probability tiers. For every 100 Retrograde Army-type monsters slain, the spawn probability tier increases by one.$(br2)The spawn cooldown for Kebiishi is 30 minutes. When Kebiishi are present near the player, the next spawn will not occur.$(br2)Players can use the #kebiishi off command to prevent Kebiishi from spawning in the world.

pages.title: Combat Traits
pages.text: In this mod, Kebiishi possess extremely powerful mechanics and strength. Their power is strongly tied to the armor the player is wearing. If you wish to defeat them, try equipping lower-level gear instead.$(br2)If successfully defeated, Kebiishi have a chance to drop rare Touken Danshi and various supplies.$(br2)Kebiishi often appear in squads and do not use ranged attacks. Players can try different combat strategies to challenge them.$(br2)Kebiishi innately possess Resistance I.

pages.name: Kebiishi · Naginata
pages.text: The basic combat unit among Kebiishi, capable of dealing high area-of-effect damage. Movement and attack speed are relatively slow.

pages.name: Kebiishi · Yari
pages.text: A Kebiishi wielding a spear with average attack range but fast attack speed. It can deal true damage, and the player's armor can only provide up to 50% of its resistance bonus.

pages.name: Kebiishi · Long Spear
pages.text: The squad leader of a Kebiishi unit, wielding a long spear. Possesses higher health and attack power. Its attacks can pierce through shields and deal true damage.

pages.name: Kebiishi · Ootachi
pages.text: The Ootachi among Kebiishi, featuring a large physique. Movement and attack speed are relatively slow, and it can deal area-of-effect splash damage.

pages.name: Kebiishi · Tachi
pages.text: The Tachi among Kebiishi. Movement and attack speed are relatively slow.
